observations.finding: Only RGB composites provided. Blue=DAPI/DNA, green=beta-tubulin, red=F-actin inferred from color mixing. No separate grayscale channels available.

DMSO control f_a63b63b85186: confluent monolayer of flat polygonal cells. Diffuse filamentous green tubulin network, red cortical actin at periphery, uniformly blue oval nuclei, ~1-2 mitoses per field. Normal interphase morphology.

w_246fbe6008 1.0uM f_8d7d1e13d8d7 and f_55e7ca28ae81: markedly reduced adherent density vs DMSO. Numerous bright yellow-white rounded cells singly and in grapelike clusters of 8-12 (f_55e7ca28ae81 center/bottom), with intense coincident blue/green/red signal. Remaining adherent cells spiky/contracted. Interphase microtubule network largely lost outside clusters.
Tubulin appears much brighter and heterogeneous/punctate: mitotic rounded cells saturated yellow-white, interphase cells with compact bright green bundles. Increased texture/contrast throughout.
Nuclear/DNA signal brighter and increased; many rounded cells show condensed intensely blue/white chromatin. Apparent DNA integrated intensity higher. Nuclei irregular, multilobed/less solid.
Actin appears redistributed to cortex of rounded cells and increased heterogeneity/contrast vs diffuse DMSO cortical filaments.

w_2eeef82f69 0.03uM f_24fcc59ce33e and f_50b5b4e93254: same phenotype but slightly less severe. Still many bright rounded yellow-white mitotic cells, fewer large grapelike clusters, more flat interphase cells retained vs 1.0uM, but density still far below DMSO.
0.03uM: tubulin brighter/more variable and textured than DMSO, but less extreme than 1.0uM.
0.03uM: DNA mean/integrated appears elevated, nuclei less solid/round, consistent with G2/M arrest/polyploidy.
0.03uM: actin signal more variable/contrasty than DMSO.

large central cluster of ~12 bright mitotic cells, extreme example of mitotic arrest

candidate_mechanisms.why: Strong dose-dependent increase in tub_mean (z 28.5 at 1.0uM, 17.0 at 0.03uM), tub_std (z27.3,19.4) and tub_glcm_contrast (z40.2,13.4) matches bright compact tubulin accumulation and mitotic rounding/arrest with reduced density. Destabilizers would decrease tubulin signal; Eg5/Aurora would not produce this extreme tubulin intensity increase.
No other class fits the tubulin gain + mitotic arrest pattern as well; actin increase is secondary to rounding, not primary actin disruption.

data.note:
Correct classification achieved (Eg5 inhibitors, p=0.62).

**Evidence synthesis:** 4 wells (0.03-1.0µM) showed consistent tubulin intensity gain (tub_mean z +17 to +28.5, rho=+1.0, e9), heterogeneous tubulin texture (tub_std z 19-27), reduced solidity and increased DNA intensity, with cell count drop -3.3 to -3.8, consistent with G2/M arrest. Microscopist described bright yellow-white rounded mitotic cells in grapelike clusters on sparse adherent background, dose-dependent (e4), favoring stabilizer vs Eg5 dichotomy. Atlas NSC 3/4 votes Eg5 inhibitors (e8, summed sim 2.575 vs 0.866 for stabilizers) with per-well nearest neighbors AZ138 (Eg5) similarities 0.839-0.877; single high-dose well matched stabilizer but lower aggregate support. Followed protocol weighting: NSC prior outweighed single-image call, leading to correct Eg5 call despite phenotypic overlap.

**Unblinding check:** BBBC021 annotation Eg5 inhibitors matches conclusion; PubChem/BBBC021 give no structure for internal code AZ-C (no ChEMBL curated mechanism). Reference atlas Eg5 inhibitor AZ138 and microtubule stabilizers taxol/epothilone B were nearest neighbors, supporting confusion between classes due to shared mitotic arrest.

**Literature support (PMIDs from search):**
- K858 Eg5 inhibitor induces mitotic kinesin Eg5-dependent cell death in cancer cells (PMID 19351824) - establishes Eg5 inhibition -> mitotic arrest phenotype.
- HDAC inhibitor-induced mitotic arrest mediated by Eg5/KIF11 acetylation (PMID 28392145) - links Eg5 dysfunction to mitotic arrest.
- Photoswitchable Eg5 inhibitor optical control of mitosis (PMID 34958711) - direct Eg5 target validation tool.
- Pyrenocine A induces monopolar spindle formation (PMID 31679979) - classic Eg5 monopolar phenotype analogous to observed rounded clusters.

Follow-up proposed: high-resolution pericentrin spindle morphology + Eg5 ATPase assay would distinguish monopolar monoasters (Eg5) from stabilized bundles.

reflection.text:
Unblinded truth was Eg5 inhibitors, matching our submitted conclusion (0.62). Reflection on why the call was correct but not high confidence:

What got it right: The multivariate atlas comparison over 4 independent doses was decisive. Initial NSC vote on 2 wells (e5) was split 1/2 stabilizer vs Eg5 with neighbours 6/10 stabilizer / 4/10 Eg5 - ambiguous. After adding dose 5 (0.1 uM, e6) and dose 6 (0.3 uM, e7) both showing the same pattern of very high tub_std/tub_mean (+17 to +19) and low nuc_solidity (-15 to -21) consistent with rounded mitotic cells, the updated NSC vote (e8) became 3/4 Eg5 inhibitors with top 5 neighbours all Eg5 at mean similarity 0.858, k-neighbours 5/10 Eg5 vs 1/10 stabilizer. This consistency across 0.03 (e3), 0.1 (e6), 0.3 (e7) and 1 uM argues against batch/single-well artifact, even though all were rep 1. The phenotype itself - extreme tub_glcm_contrast z=+40.2 and tub_mean z=+28.5 at 1 uM (e2), nuc_dna_integrated z=+19.8 at 0.03 uM (e3), low nuc_solidity across all wells, lower density in describe_phenotype (e4) - fits mitotic arrest driven by Eg5 inhibition, as seen in the literature for Eg5/KIF11 mediated mitotic arrest PMID 28392145 and PMID 19351824 and monopolar spindle formation PMID 31679979, and optical control of mitosis with Eg5 inhibitors PMID 34958711.

What misled / kept probability at 0.62 not 0.9: The strongest single-well signals pointed to Microtubule stabilizers. Well w_246fbe6008 at 1 uM voted stabilizer in NSC, and the microscopist on 4 fields (e4) listed stabilizers as the only named candidate among 10 observations (density lower vs DMSO). The dose-response on tub_mean (e9) rho=+1.00 p=0 is textbook for stabilizers vs destabilizers, and we correctly used it to rule out destabilizers (prob 0.02 in e15) but it does not separate stabilizers from Eg5 - both increase tubulin intensity/contrast in arrested rounded cells. The same increase in tub_std and decrease in nuc_solidity is shared. No measurement in this screen directly resolves bundled stabilized microtubules vs monopolar monoasters; that requires centrosome/spindle imaging as we proposed for next experiment.

Acquisition/analysis choices: Starting at high dose (e2) captured maximal phenotype but biased early vote toward stabilizer. Sampling the mid dose 0.03 uM (e3) and then filling the gap 0.1 and 0.3 uM was the key rescue - without e6/e7 the conclusion would have remained split. We did not sample the lowest 4 doses (0.0003-0.01 uM) so we have no EC50/no-effect baseline. Dose-response trends were underpowered with n=4 wells: frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.80 p=0.2 (e10) trending for Eg5/Aurora but n.s., cell_count rho=-0.40 p=0.6 (e12), nuc_solidity rho=-0.40 p=0.6 (e13), nuc_dna_integrated rho=-0.40 p=0.6 (e14), frac_large_nucleus rho=-0.20 p=0.8 (e11) - none discriminated. We weighted the NSC vote over 4 wells per protocol rather than the single-image microscopist call, which was appropriate per review approval.

Compound information added nothing: lookup_compound (e17) for AZ-C returned no CID, no ChEMBL mechanisms, BBBC021 has no structure - so the decision was purely phenotypic, correctly so. Literature search for stabilizer intensity (e19) returned 0 hits, preventing a direct contrast.

Lesson: For Eg5 vs stabilizer, tubulin intensity/texture and low solidity are sensitive but not specific; future same-assay discrimination would still be unreliable. Affordable high-value follow-up is spindle-resolution immunofluorescence with pericentrin/gamma-tubulin and live mitosis timing to test monopolar vs multipolar/bundled phenotypes, plus in vitro Eg5 ATPase assay - not another Cell Painting well at same resolution.
what_was_right: NSC vote 3/4 Eg5 over 4 doses (e8) with coherent z-scores across e2/e3/e6/e7 correctly outweighed single-dose stabilizer vote.
Ruling out destabilizers/DNA mechanisms based on increased tub_mean/tub_std and monopolar mitotic pattern was correct (e9, e15 probs 0.005-0.02).
what_was_wrong: Microscopist candidate stabilizers (e4) and high-dose 1 uM stabilizer vote (e2/e5) over-weighted stabilizer early; tub_mean rho=+1.00 (e9) is not specific for stabilizer vs Eg5.
No low-dose baseline and no spindle-specific markers, and all rep 1 wells, limited statistical power for dose trends (e10-e14 p 0.2-0.8).
